_help._: Copy this file to config.json (gitignored) and edit. Every key is optional — anything you omit falls back to the default in bin/config.py. Priority: MEETING_ROOT / MEETING_PORT env vars > config.json > built-in defaults.
_help.port: TCP port the upload server listens on. Bound to 0.0.0.0, so keep the machine on Tailscale and off the open internet.
_help.service_label: launchd label. Also decides the plist filename: ~/Library/LaunchAgents/<service_label>.plist. Must be unique on the machine; reverse-DNS style.
_help.language: Reserved default transcription language. The per-upload form value wins.
_help.notify.enabled: false = never shell out to a notifier. The pipeline still runs; the finished-message is appended to logs/undelivered.log instead.
_help.notify.bin: Path to the notifier CLI, called as `<bin> send --to <target> <message>`. Leading ~ is expanded. If the file is not executable the message is parked in logs/undelivered.log.
_help.notify.target: Channel argument passed to the notifier's --to flag.
_help.branding.brand_name: Masthead text printed at the top of every generated PDF.
_help.branding.client_footer: Footer line on client-facing PDF/Word documents (--kind client).
_help.branding.participants_hint: Placeholder text in the upload form's participants field.
_help.asr.whisper_model: HuggingFace repo or local path for mlx-whisper. Downloaded on first transcription (~1.5 GB for large-v3-turbo). Use mlx-community/whisper-medium-mlx on a memory-tight machine.
_help.asr.diarization_threads: ONNX threads for speaker diarization. 4 measured faster than 10 — more threads thrash.

branding.client_footer: 本文件內容以雙方會議討論為準。
